cues.zh: 我还记得在学校的那一天
cues.en: I still remember the day in school
when our teacher told us
that the world population had become
three billion people,
and that was in 1960.
I'm going to talk now about

cues.zh: 那一年以来世界人口是如何变化的
cues.en: how world population has changed from that year
and into the future,

cues.zh: 但这次我不用数字技术，
cues.en: but I will not use digital technology,

cues.zh: 就像我前五场TED演讲那样。
cues.en: as I've done during my first five TEDTalks.
Instead, I have progressed,
and I am, today, launching

cues.zh: 一种全新的模拟教学技术
cues.en: a brand new analog teaching technology
that I picked up from IKEA:
this box.

cues.zh: 这个盒子里装着十亿人。
cues.en: This box contains one billion people.
And our teacher told us
that the industrialized world, 1960,
had one billion people.
In the developing world, she said,
they had two billion people.
And they lived away then.

cues.zh: 两者之间存在着巨大的差距，
cues.en: There was a big gap between

cues.zh: 一边是工业化世界的十亿人，
cues.en: the one billion in the industrialized world

cues.zh: 另一边是发展中国家的二十亿人。
cues.en: and the two billion in the developing world.
In the industrialized world,
people were healthy,
educated, rich,
and they had small families.
And their aspiration
was to buy a car.
And in 1960, all Swedes were saving

cues.zh: 想买一辆这样的沃尔沃。
cues.en: to try to buy a Volvo like this.

cues.zh: 这就是瑞典当时的经济水平。
cues.en: This was the economic level at which Sweden was.
But in contrast to this,
in the developing world, far away,
the aspiration of the average family there
was to have food for the day.
They were saving
to be able to buy a pair of shoes.
There was an enormous gap in the world

cues.zh: 世界存在着巨大的鸿沟。
cues.en: when I grew up.

cues.zh: 而西方与其他地区之间的这道鸿沟
cues.en: And this gap between the West and the rest
has created a mindset of the world,

cues.zh: 我们至今在语言上仍在沿用
cues.en: which we still use linguistically
when we talk about "the West"
and "the Developing World."
But the world has changed,
and it's overdue to upgrade that mindset

cues.zh: 和这种世界分类法，并真正理解它。
cues.en: and that taxonomy of the world, and to understand it.

cues.zh: 这就是我要给大家展示的，
cues.en: And that's what I'm going to show you,
because since 1960

cues.zh: 到2010年世界上发生的变化
cues.en: what has happened in the world up to 2010
is that a staggering
four billion people
have been added to the world population.
Just look how many.

cues.zh: 世界人口已经翻了一番
cues.en: The world population has doubled
since I went to school.

cues.zh: 当然，西方也经历了经济增长。
cues.en: And of course, there's been economic growth in the West.

cues.zh: 很多公司恰好推动了经济增长，
cues.en: A lot of companies have happened to grow the economy,

cues.zh: 所以西方人口移到了这里。
cues.en: so the Western population moved over to here.

cues.zh: 现在他们的愿望不只是拥有一辆车。
cues.en: And now their aspiration is not only to have a car.

cues.zh: 现在他们想去一个非常偏远的目的地度假
cues.en: Now they want to have a holiday on a very remote destination
and they want to fly.

cues.zh: 这就是他们今天所处的位置。
cues.en: So this is where they are today.

cues.zh: 而最成功的发展中国家，
cues.en: And the most successful of the developing countries,

cues.zh: 它们已经向前迈进，你知道，
cues.en: they have moved on, you know,

cues.zh: 它们成了我们所说的新兴经济体。
cues.en: and they have become emerging economies, we call them.
They are now buying cars.
And what happened a month ago
was that the Chinese company, Geely,

cues.zh: 他们收购了沃尔沃公司，
cues.en: they acquired the Volvo company,
and then finally the Swedes understood that
something big had happened in the world.
(Laughter)
So there they are.

cues.zh: 悲剧的是，这里的二十亿人
cues.en: And the tragedy is that the two billion over here

cues.zh: 还在为食物和鞋子挣扎，
cues.en: that is struggling for food and shoes,
they are still almost as poor
as they were 50 years ago.
The new thing is that

cues.zh: 我们有最大的一堆数十亿人，这里的三十亿人，
cues.en: we have the biggest pile of billions, the three billions here,

cues.zh: 他们也正在成为新兴经济体，
cues.en: which are also becoming emerging economies,

cues.zh: 因为他们相当健康，受教育程度相对较高，
cues.en: because they are quite healthy, relatively well-educated,

cues.zh: 而且他们也已经每人有两个到三个孩子，
cues.en: and they already also have two to three children

cues.zh: 和那些[更富有的]人一样。
cues.en: per woman, as those [richer also] have.
And their aspiration now
is, of course, to buy a bicycle,

cues.zh: 然后之后他们还想要一辆摩托车。
cues.en: and then later on they would like to have a motorbike also.
But this is the world
we have today,
no longer any gap.
But the distance from the poorest here, the very poorest,

cues.zh: 到此处最富有的人，差距比以往任何时候都大。
cues.en: to the very richest over here is wider than ever.

cues.zh: 但这是一个连续的世界，
cues.en: But there is a continuous world
from walking, biking,
driving, flying --
there are people on all levels,

cues.zh: 而大多数人往往处于中间某处。
cues.en: and most people tend to be somewhere in the middle.
This is the new world we have today
And what will happen in the future?
Well, I'm going to project
into 2050.
I was in Shanghai recently,

cues.zh: 听了听中国正在发生的事，
cues.en: and I listened to what's happening in China,

cues.zh: 可以肯定他们会赶上来，
cues.en: and it's pretty sure that they will catch up,
just as Japan did.

cues.zh: 所有预测都[说]这[十亿]只会以
cues.en: All the projections [say that] this one [billion] will [only] grow with

cues.zh: 百分之一到二或三增长。
cues.en: one to two or three percent.

cues.zh: [但第二个十亿]以百分之七、八增长，然后他们最终会到这里。
cues.en: [But this second] grows with seven, eight percent, and then they will end up here.
They will start flying.
And these

cues.zh: 中低收入国家，新兴收入国家，
cues.en: lower or middle income countries, the emerging income countries,

cues.zh: 它们在经济上也会继续向前发展。
cues.en: they will also forge forwards economically.
And if,
but only if,

cues.zh: 我们投资于正确的绿色技术——
cues.en: we invest in the right green technology --

cues.zh: 才能避免严重的气候变化，
cues.en: so that we can avoid severe climate change,

cues.zh: 同时能源还能保持相对便宜——
cues.en: and energy can still be relatively cheap --

cues.zh: 那么它们就会一路发展到这个水平。
cues.en: then they will move all the way up here.
And they will start to buy
electric cars.

cues.zh: 这就是我们会在那里看到的情况。
cues.en: This is what we will find there.

cues.zh: 那最贫困的二十亿人呢？
cues.en: So what about the poorest two billion?

cues.zh: 这里最贫困的二十亿人呢？
cues.en: What about the poorest two billion here?
Will they move on?

cues.zh: 嗯，这就涉及人口[增长]了
cues.en: Well, here population [growth] comes in

cues.zh: 因为在那里[新兴经济体中]每名女性已经只生育两到三个孩子，
cues.en: because there [among emerging economies] we already have two to three children per woman,

cues.zh: 计划生育已被广泛使用，
cues.en: family planning is widely used,
and population growth is coming to an end.

cues.zh: 而这里[最贫困人群中]，人口仍在增长。
cues.en: Here [among the poorest], population is growing.

cues.zh: 未来几十年，这最贫困的二十亿人
cues.en: So these [poorest] two billion will, in the next decades,
increase to three billion,
and they will thereafter
increase to four billion.
There is nothing --

cues.zh: 除了我们从未见过的那种核战争——
cues.en: but a nuclear war of a kind we've never seen --
that can stop this [growth] from happening.

cues.zh: 因为这个增长已经在进行中了。
cues.en: Because we already have this [growth] in process.
But if, and only if,
[the poorest] get out of poverty,

cues.zh: 获得教育，儿童存活率提高，
cues.en: they get education, they get improved child survival,

cues.zh: 能买得起自行车和手机，搬到这里生活，
cues.en: they can buy a bicycle and a cell phone and come [to live] here,
then population growth
will stop in 2050.

cues.zh: 我们不能让这个层面的人
cues.en: We cannot have people on this level

cues.zh: 还在为食物和鞋子奔波，
cues.en: looking for food and shoes

cues.zh: 因为那样人口就会持续增长。
cues.en: because then we get continued population growth.
And let me show you why
by converting back to the old-time
digital technology.
Here I have on the screen
my country bubbles.

cues.zh: 每个气泡代表一个国家，大小表示人口。
cues.en: Every bubble is a country. The size is population.
The colors show the continent.
The yellow on there is the Americas;

cues.zh: 深蓝色是非洲，棕色是欧洲；
cues.en: dark blue is Africa; brown is Europe;
green is the Middle East
and this light blue is South Asia.

cues.zh: 这是印度，这是中国。大小表示人口。
cues.en: That's India and this is China. Size is population.

cues.zh: 这里显示的是每名妇女生育子女数：
cues.en: Here I have children per woman:

cues.zh: 两个孩子、四个孩子、六个孩子、八个孩子——
cues.en: two children, four children, six children, eight children --
big families, small families.
The year is 1960.

cues.zh: 下面这里是儿童存活率，
cues.en: And down here, child survival,
the percentage of children surviving childhood
up to starting school:
60 percent, 70 percent, 80 percent, 90,
and almost 100 percent, as we have today

cues.zh: 最富裕、最健康的国家那样。
cues.en: in the wealthiest and healthiest countries.

cues.zh: 但看，这就是1960年我老师讲的那个世界：
cues.en: But look, this is the world my teacher talked about in 1960:
one billion Western world here --

cues.zh: 儿童存活率高、家庭规模小——
cues.en: high child-survival, small families --
and all the rest,

cues.zh: 这些五彩缤纷的发展中国家，
cues.en: the rainbow of developing countries,
with very large families
and poor child survival.

cues.zh: 发生了什么？我来启动这个世界。开始吧。
cues.en: What has happened? I start the world. Here we go.

cues.zh: 你们能看到吗，随着时间推移，儿童存活率在上升？
cues.en: Can you see, as the years pass by, child survival is increasing?

cues.zh: 他们获得了肥皂、卫生、教育，
cues.en: They get soap, hygiene, education,
vaccination, penicillin

cues.zh: 然后是计划生育。家庭规模在缩小。
cues.en: and then family planning. Family size is decreasing.

cues.zh: 当儿童存活率达到90%时，家庭规模就开始缩小，
cues.en: [When] they get up to 90-percent child survival, then families decrease,

cues.zh: 而中东大多数阿拉伯国家
cues.en: and most of the Arab countries in the Middle East
is falling down there [to small families].

cues.zh: 看，孟加拉国正在赶上印度。
cues.en: Look, Bangladesh catching up with India.
The whole emerging world
joins the Western world

cues.zh: 拥有良好的儿童存活率
cues.en: with good child survival
and small family size,

cues.zh: 但我们仍有最贫困的十亿人。
cues.en: but we still have the poorest billion.

cues.zh: 你们能看到最贫困的十亿人吗，
cues.en: Can you see the poorest billion,

cues.zh: 就是我刚才放在这里的两个方框？
cues.en: those [two] boxes I had over here?
They are still up here.
And they still have a child survival
of only 70 to 80 percent,

cues.zh: 这意味着如果出生六个孩子，
cues.en: meaning that if you have six children born,
there will be at least four who survive
to the next generation.

cues.zh: 人口会在一代之内翻倍。
cues.en: And the population will double in one generation.
So the only way

cues.zh: 真正让世界人口增长停下来
cues.en: of really getting world population [growth] to stop

cues.zh: 就是继续提高儿童存活率
cues.en: is to continue to improve child survival
to 90 percent.

cues.zh: 这就是为什么盖茨基金会、
cues.en: That's why investments by Gates Foundation,
UNICEF and aid organizations,

cues.zh: 加上最贫困国家的政府，
cues.en: together with national government in the poorest countries,
are so good;
because they are actually
helping us to reach

cues.zh: 世界人口的可持续规模。
cues.en: a sustainable population size of the world.

cues.zh: 如果我们做对了，可以停在九十亿。
cues.en: We can stop at nine billion if we do the right things.

cues.zh: 儿童存活率就是新的环保。
cues.en: Child survival is the new green.
It's only by child survival

cues.zh: 我们才能停止人口增长。
cues.en: that we will stop population growth.
And will it happen?
Well, I'm not an optimist,
neither am I a pessimist.

cues.zh: 我是一个非常严肃的“可能主义者”。
cues.en: I'm a very serious "possibilist."

cues.zh: 这是一个新类别，我们把情绪拆解开来，
cues.en: It's a new category where we take emotion apart,

cues.zh: 只用分析的方式对待世界。
cues.en: and we just work analytically with the world.
It can be done.

cues.zh: 我们可以拥有一个更加公正的世界。
cues.en: We can have a much more just world.
With green technology

cues.zh: 以及为缓解贫困而投入的资金，
cues.en: and with investments to alleviate poverty,
and global governance,
the world can become like this.

cues.zh: 再看看旧西方所处的位置。
cues.en: And look at the position of the old West.

cues.zh: 还记得这个蓝色方块曾经孤零零地
cues.en: Remember when this blue box was all alone,

cues.zh: 引领世界、过着自己的日子吗？
cues.en: leading the world, living its own life.
This will not happen [again].

cues.zh: 旧西方在新世界中的角色，
cues.en: The role of the old West in the new world
is to become the foundation
of the modern world --
nothing more, nothing less.

cues.zh: 但这是一个非常重要的角色。
cues.en: But it's a very important role.
Do it well and get used to it.
Thank you very much.
(Applause)
